results.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
results.reason: This technical report releases a new LLM family with dense and MoE architectures; the body specifies the architecture.
results.evidence: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures

results.title: Searching for Activation Functions
results.reason: The paper proposes Swish, a new activation function that can be dropped into any neural network, including language-model FFN blocks, even though it is evaluated on image classification.
results.evidence: the best discovered activation function, $f(x) = x \cdot \text{sigmoid}(βx)$, which we name Swish

results.title: Transformers without Normalization
results.reason: Proposes Dynamic Tanh, an element-wise operation that replaces normalization layers in Transformers, which is a buildable architectural component.
results.evidence: as a drop-in replacement for normalization layers in Transformers

results.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
results.reason: The paper proposes Mamba, a new sequence-model backbone built from selective state-space layers whose parameters depend on the input, used in place of attention and MLP blocks.
results.architecture_kind: selective state-space model layer / attention-free backbone
results.evidence: We integrate these selective SSMs into a simplified end-to-end neural network architecture without attention or even MLP blocks (Mamba).

results.title: Primer: Searching for Efficient Transformers for Language Modeling
results.reason: The paper proposes Primer, a Transformer variant for language modeling that uses squared ReLU activations and adds depthwise convolutions after the Q, K, and V projections in self-attention.
results.architecture_kind: Transformer variant (squared ReLU FFN activation + depthwise convolution in attention)
results.evidence: squaring ReLU activations and adding a depthwise convolution layer after each Q, K, and V projection in self-attention
